data.one_liner: Flutter client for DeepSeek's AI API, enabling chat completions and model management.
data.what_it_does: The package wraps DeepSeek's REST endpoints, offering methods for chat completions, model listing, and streaming responses. It uses Dio for HTTP calls and allows custom configuration.
use_when: You need to call DeepSeek's LLM from a Flutter app
You require simple model management without building your own HTTP layer
avoid_when: You require a full state‑management solution
You depend on a different AI provider
strengths: Easy to integrate with just an API key
weaknesses: No code generation or model classes beyond basics
